en.title: Listing Archery Products and Managing Inventory
en.excerpt: How sellers create product listings, configure specifications like draw weight and arrow spine, manage stock quantities, and upload photo galleries.
en.content:
Creating a New Product Listing

To list an item, open Seller Dashboard > Products > + Add Product and provide the item title, category (Bows, Arrows, Targets, Accessories, Apparel), and description.

Archery-Specific Variations

Archery gear requires precise technical specs. You can create item variations with custom pricing and stock levels:

  • Bows: Draw weight (e.g., 28 lbs, 32 lbs, 36 lbs) and dexterity (Right Hand / Left Hand).
  • Arrows: Spine value (e.g., 400, 500, 600, 700), shaft length, and vane color.
  • Target Faces: Dimensions (122cm, 80cm 6-ring, 40cm single/triple spot) and pack quantities.

Pricing & Inventory Tracking

Set base pricing in IDR and track stock units. The system automatically marks items as Out of Stock when inventory reaches zero, preventing accidental backorders.

Product Photography Guidelines

Upload clean, well-lit images (1:1 aspect ratio, minimum 800x800 px) showing the product from multiple angles, including close-ups of risers, limb tips, and packaging.
